description: ui-health is the single authority for every static UI-interop check. app-monitor must consume the `InteropComplianceReport` API-to-API over `api-core/discovery` rather than re-implementing interop checks, and must degrade to an "interop unavailable" state if ui-health is down rather than failing or producing false results.

requirements.description: All static UI-interop checks must run from within ui-health and be exposed via an `InteropComplianceReport`. No other scenario may hand-roll a duplicate static interop check; ui-health is the single source of truth for interop compliance.
requirements.title: All static UI-interop checks run from ui-health

validation.notes: ui-health produces an InteropComplianceReport covering every static interop check
Each interop check is registered exactly once within ui-health's check registry
Run ui-health against a scenario with an interop violation and confirm the InteropComplianceReport reports it
ui-health is the single authority for static UI-interop compliance; no duplicate interop check exists in another scenario

requirements.description: app-monitor must consume the `InteropComplianceReport` from ui-health over Connect via `api-core/discovery`. When ui-health is unreachable, app-monitor must degrade gracefully to an "interop unavailable" state instead of erroring or reporting false compliance.
requirements.title: app-monitor consumes report over Connect and degrades gracefully

validation.notes: app-monitor resolves ui-health via api-core/discovery and fetches the InteropComplianceReport over Connect
When ui-health is unreachable, app-monitor surfaces interop unavailable rather than an error or false compliance
With ui-health running, app-monitor reflects the InteropComplianceReport contents end-to-end
With ui-health stopped, app-monitor reports interop unavailable and remains functional
app-monitor does not maintain its own copy of interop logic; it is purely a consumer of ui-health's report

title: Static UI-interop authority
